services.desc: Check out our virtual or self-guided tours of a few highlighted areas of City Park: Get to the root of the Park’s design. From the beginning, the live oaks of City Park have been part of the heritage of New Orleans. These beautiful old trees have stood as silent sentinels as the park developed into the urban oasis it is today. City Park will continue to provide the care needed so that generations to come may enjoy the most significant collection of mature live oaks found anywhere. From wooden beams to concrete arches-take a pebbled look at the Park’s past. The City Park Bridges Tour can be taken virtually or in-person.
